payload.outcome: Implemented a cross-platform, fail-closed dead-code candidate gate: repository-rooted Node filesystem scans replace external grep, reported paths and Windows separator exclusions are normalized, git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository supplies history state, and failed search, diff, or history checks refuse instead of clearing. Unfinished plans refuse while completed plans warn; committed tests, dynamic literals, recent or unknown introduction history, sibling exports, and signature-change filtering remain protected. Focused proof passed 10/10 in tests/dead-code-candidate.test.ts, and npm run check:dead-code-candidate passed its self-test plus default diff gate.
